'''Class A Code Red''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] classification. Individuals classified as [[Class A Security Risk]]s could be elevated to Class A Code Red if they were in transit from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to a secure area. To prevent the loss of a valuable resource in the event of their capture, Imperial Intelligence ordered the individuals to be injected with approved [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] substances.<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
